errors.evidence: The description states there are four segments, but the chart and legend show five: "бензин" (gasoline), "дизел" (diesel), "електрически" (electric), "хибридни" (hybrid), and "други" (other).
The description states that the "електрически" (electric) segment is red, but in the chart it is represented by a dark brown/grey slice.
The description states that the "хибридни" (hybrid) segment is blue, but in the chart it is represented by a yellow slice.

errors.evidence: The entire mapping of values to fuel types is incorrect. The correct values are: "бензин" is 1,071,600; "дизел" is 1,456,846; "електрически" is 51,910; "хибридни" is 13,466; and "други" is 414,098. The description scrambles these values completely and omits some.
The description completely omits the fifth category, "други" (other), which is present in the legend (dark blue) and chart with a value of 414,098.
